headline: The Pentagon's Tradewinds initiative is speeding up 'kill chain' AI purchases from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, as SIPRI joined the EU's non-proliferation consultative meeting and the US backed a $1 billion quantum chip manufacturing award.

points.text: The US government's Tradewinds initiative is making it easier to speed millions of dollars to 'nontraditional' defense contractors for 'kill chain' AI purchases, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.
SIPRI experts took part in the 15th EU Non-Proliferation and Disarmament Consortium Consultative Meeting in Brussels.
JIATF-401 is widening its counter-drone options beyond directed energy to include AI and hardening, as the Pentagon pursues a broader mix of defenses against the drone threat.
General Dynamics tapped Primordial Labs to build an AI voice assistant for combat vehicle crews, designed to translate soldiers' voice commands into actions — but not lethal ones.
The US Commerce Department finalized a $1 billion CHIPS and Science Act award to Anderon, a quantum foundry established by IBM, to back domestic quantum chip manufacturing.
A newsletter examined how a potential FCC rule on optical transceivers overlooks important US-China technology dependencies.
Trump is set to attend an AI science summit meant to position the US as a leader in breakthroughs driven by 'super intelligence.'
